assignment: ER12 A7-02 control full pipeline only
summary: The completed final meets all eight original obligations and all four negative constraints. Independent governing primary evidence supports consequential claims and the plan/critique dispositions. No remaining material error, material omission or unsupported consequential decision was found. Limitations are bounded discovery/navigation/prospective-trace issues; interoperability and owner policy choices remain honestly unresolved. Native, runtime and billing judgments remain separate.

axes.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axes.assessment: The final is a complete planning proposal for the original pilot, with two manager/export workflows and a Crossref reconciliation analogy; DOI-less/manual handling; same-manifestation review; distinct preprint/journal records; immutable submissions and credit; optional reviewed lookup and optional bibliography export; a bounded released failure chain; fixed editor authority and open lead inputs. All four negative constraints survive. No installation, production access, accounts, purchases, prototype, or deployment is an invented prerequisite.

axes.name: Consequential source claims and applicability
axes.assessment: Independent primary retrieval supports the consequential manager operations, lookup defaults and identifier prerequisites, format-loss warning, Crossref member-deposit scope and typed relations, public/polite access distinction, and issue/fix/release/code chain. The final distinguishes documentation dates from application releases and makes no unsupported claim of tested interoperability. Exact domain limits were checked: Crossref schema status means withdrawn/removed, not a universal publication stage; DOI/non-DOI deposit validation is provider-specific; formatter handling is not general RIS correctness. The S19 summary is selective about the older title/first-author notification mechanism and does not develop the newer heuristic strategy. That is a breadth/locator limitation, not a false recommendation or material identity decision.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, alternatives, implementation/history, opportunity breadth
axes.assessment: The brief-only discovery provides materially different Zotero and JabRef workflows, not a list of names, and a useful Crossref typed-link analogy that preserves related manifestations. It investigates a released page-range exporter failure, then the draft adds pinned formatter source/test evidence and the beta's limited LibreOffice CSL compatibility opportunity. Optional RIS, alternative interchange/rendering choices, DOI and text-search enrichment, manual/no-match retention, and provenance are concrete opportunities with conditions. This is sufficient bounded discovery under a brief expressly preferring useful examples over an exhaustive catalogue. The carried S19 source also offers a newer fuzzy matching strategy and experimental API; these are not explored. I do not turn that additional possible investigation into a mandatory feature or a material omission.

auxiliary_plan_dispositions.clause: Pilot intent and tentative product leads
auxiliary_plan_dispositions.exact_original:
A public science group curates a monthly reading list from submitted citations. Volunteers need to merge duplicates, retain the submitted reference, correct obvious metadata errors and export citations to common reference managers. Some papers lack persistent identifiers; preprints and later journal articles must remain distinguishable. The group publishes citations and links, not copies of full articles.

The team has tentatively discussed Zotero or JabRef. These are investigation leads, not selected winners. The mechanism needing investigation is citation formats, persistent identifiers and duplicate/version reconciliation; a useful historical inquiry concerns released metadata-import or citation-export regressions. Do not let these leads prevent discovery of a better fit or an analogous mechanism.
auxiliary_plan_dispositions.assessment: Monthly citation-only pilot scope, original preservation and version distinction are retained. Zotero/JabRef are assessed leads rather than locked selections; Crossref supplies a meaningful analogous mechanism. No mandatory deployment or full-article publication is inferred.
